title: Replication package for "When AI Knows Better but Chooses Worse: Persuasion in Investment Recommendations" (Study 1 v3/v3.1)
description: Code, prompts, persuasive documents, verified fund data, all model responses (29,600 analyzed calls from eleven models, plus pilot calls), manual quality-gate reviews and analysis outputs (tables, figures, results summaries) for Study 1 v3/v3.1 of an experiment on whether large language model agents choose the lower-cost fund among funds tracking the same index, and whether one persuasive document changes that choice. docs/REPLICATION.md maps each table, figure and number in the manuscript to its data and script. Issuer fact sheets are not redistributed; their URLs and as-of dates are in the fund data files. Earlier iterations of the project are not included.
